evals.prompt: Project root has .session-decisions.md matching evals/files/session-decisions.md (next: D1). User: /next-decision
evals.expected_output: Full review of D1 only, then advance next to D2
expectations: Reviews D1 in full (choice, alternatives, why, stakes, trade-offs, review point)
Does not review D2 or D3 in this run
Does not treat next as a future decision to make or say those choices are already done

evals.prompt: Same .session-decisions.md with next: D1. User: /next-decision D2
evals.expected_output: Full review of D2 only; leave next at D1
expectations: Leaves next: unchanged because the explicit id D2 is not the current next: value
Uses the full review recipe, not a one-line restatement

evals.prompt: Mid-implementation the user says we decided to use Postgres. Do not run next-decision. Continue implementing.
expectations: Does not trigger on a passing mention of a decision
Triggers only on /next-decision or /next-decision with an id

evals.prompt: Project root has .session-decisions.md matching evals/files/session-decisions-done.md (next: done, D1–D3). User: /next-decision
evals.expected_output: Every listed decision has been reviewed. Do not call done an unknown id.
expectations: Says every listed decision has been reviewed
Does not call the id unknown
Does not write a D1–D3 review recipe

evals.prompt: Same .session-decisions.md with next: done and D1–D3. User: /next-decision D2
evals.expected_output: Full D2 recipe; leave next: done
expectations: Reviews D2 with the full recipe even though next: is done
Does not apply the done short-circuit to an explicit id

evals.prompt: Conversation already contains a D1–D3 grok list (persist .session-decisions.md, skip harness, YAGNI). Project root has no .session-decisions.md. User: /next-decision
evals.expected_output: Write .session-decisions.md from the in-session grok list (next: D1 or advance from D1) and review D1 only
expectations: Writes .session-decisions.md even though a grok list already exists in chat
Reuses the in-session grok list instead of requiring a second scan
